headline: Six fresh frontier items shipped — the studio's own instruments now publish their evidence (uptime, field-wins) instead of measuring into the void.

items.title: First-party uptime now publishes to /status/
items.insight: The probe went green on its first real run but was throwing the result away — the workflow never committed it and the status tile sat empty. Now it commits a 30-day availability rollup low-churn and /status/ shows a number the studio measured itself, not a third-party badge.
items.evidence: check-uptime-contract 7/7 · first scheduled run green 40s @ 01:39Z · api/uptime.json + data/uptime-history.ndjson live

items.title: The alarm proves itself without paging the founder
items.insight: An alert path you've never seen fire is an act of faith. A --simulate-failure mode now runs the full down-to-email path and prints the exact message it would send, so the founder has evidence the alarm works without a 3am false page.
items.evidence: probe-uptime --simulate-failure PASS · self-test 14/14 · module made import-safe

items.title: The measurement machine publishes its own wins
items.insight: The RUM loop already graded the origin migration at a -83% homepage LCP drop, but that win was buried in a JSON file. A new publisher surfaces confirmed verdicts only — so the proof tile auto-lights the moment the evidence is statistically honest and stays dark until then.
items.evidence: build-field-win-proof 6/6 · api/field-win.json (honest-dark, 0 confirmed today) · /status/ tile wired

items.title: Returning visitors finally see momentum
items.insight: A returning prospect used to get the same cold homepage as a first-timer, with no sign anything had moved. A dismissible 'since your last visit, N things shipped' strip — seeded from the public Forge Ledger and a local baseline — gives them a concrete reason to look again.
items.evidence: offline Playwright proof 3/3 · idle-loaded via ambient predicate · cost-neutral (localStorage + static JSON)

items.title: Genome strip off the cold-cache path
items.insight: Every first paint was paying to download the studio-health strip whether or not it rendered. Moving it behind the predicate loader trims the always-loaded ambient bundle, attacking the same first-paint metric the origin migration targets.
items.evidence: feature bundle 28→27 sources · coverage + placement gates green · shell re-propagated

items.title: TASK_BOARD shrunk 365KB → 130KB
items.insight: Fifteen sessions of completed work had buried the live board, taxing every on-demand read. A rotator archives everything older than the last three sessions — nothing deleted — so the working board stays lean and future sessions read cheaper.
items.evidence: 365KB→130KB (-63%) · self-test 7/7 · session-window --check-size advisory in build:check · import-safe

followUps: Confirm api/field-win.json flips hasConfirmed once / accrues ≥5 post-deploy samples — first end-to-end proof of the self-publishing loop
Verify the first low-churn uptime-probe.yml commit lands api/uptime.json + a history row and /status/ shows a real %
blockers: Founder device verify: membership proof loop + nav-sheet
